signature.name: VTask.nullHomotopicMap
signature.type: {ι : Type u_1} -> {V : Type u} -> [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} V] -> [CategoryTheory.Preadditive V] -> {c : ComplexShape ι} -> {C D : HomologicalComplex V c} -> (hom : (i j : ι) → C.X i ⟶ D.X j) -> C ⟶ D

conventions.statement: If k₀ is an index such that neither c.Rel k₀ l nor c.Rel l k₀ holds for any l, then (VTask.nullHomotopicMap hom).f k₀ = 0 for any hom.
conventions.note: Both the dNext and prevD summands vanish at an isolated degree.

conventions.statement: The values hom i j for pairs (i, j) where c.Rel j i is false and c.Rel i j is false have no effect on the resulting chain map.
conventions.note: Only hom values along adjacent (rel) pairs contribute to component maps.

facts.statement: ∀ {ι : Type*} {V : Type*} [CategoryTheory.Category V] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive V] {c : ComplexShape ι} {C D : HomologicalComplex V c} (hom : ∀ i j, C.X i ⟶ D.X j) {k₀ : ι} (hk₀ : ∀ l : ι, ¬c.Rel k₀ l) (hk₀' : ∀ l : ι, ¬c.Rel l k₀), (VTask.nullHomotopicMap hom).f k₀ = 0

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ {ι : Type*} {V : Type*} [CategoryTheory.Category V] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive V] {c : ComplexShape ι} {C D : HomologicalComplex V c}, VTask.nullHomotopicMap (fun i j => (0 : C.X i ⟶ D.X j)) = 0

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; unvalidated by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ {ι : Type*} {V : Type*} [CategoryTheory.Category V] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive V] {W : Type*} [CategoryTheory.Category W] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive W] {c : ComplexShape ι} {C D : HomologicalComplex V c} (G : CategoryTheory.Functor V W) [G.Additive] (hom : ∀ i j, C.X i ⟶ D.X j), (G.mapHomologicalComplex c).map (VTask.nullHomotopicMap hom) = VTask.nullHomotopicMap (fun i j => G.map (hom i j))
